# excellent

A small, idiomatic TypeScript project used as a positive fixture for sipcode
score. It demonstrates an agent-friendly layout: a CLAUDE.md routing file,
an AGENTS.md manifest, conventional source directories, descriptive
filenames, colocated tests, and a lockfile.

## Quick start

```
npm install
npm run build
npm test
```

## Architecture

See `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for the high-level data flow.
